name: bboxy450-term visual style

sources.swarm_block: Range Rover 2023 rear: band set into a rounded body, bumper carries the colour
sources.sizes: macOS proportions at a compact footprint (cozy density)

rules: one material for every surface: translucent, blurred, hairline-edged; no opaque boxes
hairlines, never borders; the only solid borders are pane borders, which carry identity
selection is a tint of the foreground, never a colour
colour means identity only: a seat's colour, a swarm's colour, a role's colour; state is glyph and glow
numbers live in badges, kinds live in muted text on the right, icons live in tiles
one radius scale, one type scale, one spacing grid; nothing is sized by eye
shadows only under floating things; flat things cast none
motion is one curve and one duration; nothing animates without a cause

components.panel: frosted surface at panel_alpha with panel_blur, radius.panel, hairline ring, shadow.floating, inner top highlight
components.card: flat surface at card_alpha, radius.card, outside hairline ring (material.hairline_px, hair), no inner highlight, no shadow: the swarm block body (padding s2 s2 0, rows on a body padded s1 0 s2), the new-swarm button and Box card
components.row: radius.row, margin row_margin_x, selection tint on select, hover tint on hover, tile · title · subtitle · kind · badge; inside the swarm card: radius.row, padding 0 s4, margin 0 s1
components.tile: radius.tile square in the harness colour, white glyph inside
components.badge: radius.badge square, badge_alpha tint, mono digits (⌘N, numbers)
components.pill: radius.pill, panel material, shadow.pill; floating actions with kbd hints
components.section: type.section at weight_section, muted, sentence case
components.band: swarm colour gloss band set into the card top: radius.tile, height spacing.band, padding 0 s6, note 600 tracked .16em uppercase
components.bumper: 4px strip of swarm colour along the card bottom, 3px when shut
components.new_swarm: card-shaped button under the swarm cards: the card Style at spacing.new_swarm high, row 500 fg-dim
components.hud: the panel Style at instrument size: frosted panel_alpha, radius.card, hairline ring, shadow.floating, padding s5 s6, micro mono; the perf overlay (Cmd+Opt+F)
